assessment.reason: All four channels show elevated shaft 1x 0.0105-0.0143 with 1x>>2x>>3x (ratios ~3.9-7.3) and low 3x <0.001. Reference normal trials have 1x ~0.0004-0.0015; reference misalignment trials have low 1x ~0.0003-0.0011 with dominant 2x ~0.011-0.015 on ch0/2, opposite to query. Query matches reference unbalance trials with 1x 0.004-0.015 dominating 2x 0.0005-0.005 and low kurtosis ~3.1-4.0, crest ~4.7-6.7 indicating largely sinusoidal. Limitation: reference looseness can also show high 1x ~0.006-0.012 with low harmonics in one trial, and radial-only short recording cannot fully exclude looseness or combined faults; assessment based only on supplied features.
